summary: Phase L.26 / Phase 1D verification — AHU equipment modal extraction into /js/dashboard/ahu-modal.js. All 9 review-request criteria PASS. AHU modal opens via ?modal_ahu=AHU-01-E with z-[130] container and 'AHU-01-E EQUIPMENT DIAGRAM' title; real-time pills render (OAT, SAT, INV1_F, INV2_F, BAND B5 yellow pill, VFD chassis SVG); QR overlay opens correctly with 'show' class, embedded SVG, and deep-link '#/ahu/AHU-01-E'; POP OUT spawns a second page (context.pages 1→2 and page-event fires); ahu-modal.js loads with HTTP 200, correct JSDoc header, and is sandwiched between vav-modal.js and app.js in the jsModules loader; pill computed transforms are all clamped in [0.8, 1.2] (9/9 sampled in range); VAV modal regression (?modal_vav=VAV-1-E-A) still renders z-[120] modal with correct title; boot smoke clean — typeof renderAhuEquipmentModal === 'function', typeof renderVavEquipmentModal === 'function', no Babel red overlay, no pageerrors.
critical_code_review_comments: app.js still 4255 lines after extraction — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Next obvious split targets (per shrink trajectory): plugin/PSYCH chart panel, sidebar/header chrome, or settings drawer. Each is likely a 300–600 line IIFE/component candidate.

ctx prop interface for ahu-modal is 23 keys (vav is 24) — wide and order-independent but un-typechecked. Already noted in JSDoc as a future React.memo refactor; recommend addressing before adding more extracted modules so the boundary stays declarative.

Pre-existing 4× 404 console errors on dashboard.html load — same observation as iteration 8, unrelated to this extraction. Likely missing asset/icon paths; worth one cleanup pass to remove noise and make real regressions easier to spot.
seed_data_creation: None — dev /api/data already returns AHU-01-E with full schema so the modal renders real VFD chassis + pills, not the placeholder.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1D (AHU modal extraction) is GREEN. Pattern now verified for two modules: vav-modal.js (z-[120]) and ahu-modal.js (z-[130]). When future extractions land (likely plugin panel, sidebar, or settings drawer per app.js shrink plan), re-verify by: (1) curl the new module path expecting 200 + JSDoc header start, (2) grep dashboard.html jsModules array for correct ordering BEFORE app.js, (3) load the corresponding URL deep-link and check the modal/panel container with its z-index class, (4) re-run AHU+VAV smoke tests as regressions, (5) confirm typeof renderXxx === 'function' at window scope, (6) verify no Babel red overlay.
